t: What Robot Sensor Calibration Database Is All About
title: What Robot Sensor Calibration Database Is All About
description: Sensor calibration makes measurements true: camera intrinsics (focal length, distortion) via checkerboards, hand-eye (camera to robot transform), force sensor zeroing and scaling, LiDAR extrinsic alignment. Uncertainty (±mm) propagates to grasp success. Recalibrate on schedule and after impacts. Uncalibrated sensors are confident liars. This database is the complete calibration record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
